decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-007935 (1400.77 EUR, SALTMARSH JOURNEYS, card CRD-000174) was posted on 2026-08-22, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-26. That is 65 days, inside the 120-day limit. Its authorisation AUTH-008141 was an ECOMMERCE payment with 3-D Secure AUTHENTICATED, CVV MATCH, fraud flag false, and it was approved. Under the policy, an online payment the cardholder confirmed with 3-D Secure, with no fraud flag, counts as made by the cardholder, and a matching CVV supports this. So the dispute is declined. The only earlier purchase at this merchant on this card is TXN-005501 (893.21 EUR, posted 2026-08-16), which was before the disputed payment. Later purchases at the same merchant were also posted: TXN-005505 on 2026-08-30 and TXN-005522 on 2026-09-14. The cardholder did not dispute either. This is supporting context, not the deciding rule. The cardholder says the card never left them, but that does not change the outcome for a card-not-present payment that was confirmed with 3-D Secure.

proposed_actions.reason: This was an online payment that was confirmed with 3-D Secure, the bank's online payment check, and the correct card security code was entered. The bank's fraud screening raised no flag. Under our policy, a payment confirmed this way is treated as made by the cardholder, so we cannot treat it as unauthorised.
